description: This file contains integration tests for the Client functionalities in the Fineract project, including creating clients, updating status, addresses, and verifying client data.

classes.name: ClientTest
classes.description: Contains integration tests for client creation, status updates, address handling, and other client-related operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets global configurations after each test.

methods.name: testClientStatus
methods.description: Tests client lifecycle status changes (activate, close, reject, reactivate, withdraw).

methods.name: testClientAsPersonStatus
methods.description: Tests client creation and status transitions when the client is a person.

methods.name: testClientAsEntityStatus
methods.description: Tests client creation and status transitions when the client is an entity.

methods.name: testPendingOnlyClientRequest
methods.description: Validates filtering clients by pending and active statuses.

methods.name: testClientAddressCreationWorks
methods.description: Verifies that client address creation works correctly when address feature is enabled.

methods.name: testClientAddressCreationWorksAfterClientIsCreated
methods.description: Tests adding an address to an existing client.

methods.name: testClientName
methods.description: Validates creating clients with specific name fields and retrieving display names.
